_readme: Voices for tools/generate-clips.mjs. Fill in each voice_id from your ElevenLabs account (never put the API key here; it comes from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable). 'momster' must be the same voice, model and settings that made the tutorial lines (audio/momster/tour_*.mp3). Each villain has a fixed voice of their own; 'description' is a prompt you can paste into ElevenLabs Voice Design to get a candidate.

momster.description: Momster, the helper: warm, upbeat, a little silly. Same voice as the tutorial lines.

villains/m_sock.description: Stinky Sock Goblin: raspy, gleeful, scheming goblin who cackles.

villains/m_crumb.description: Captain Crumbs: hearty, boastful pirate captain who loves snacks.

villains/m_dust.description: Dust Bunny Boss: wheezy, sneezy mob boss with a raspy whisper.

villains/m_toy.description: Toy Tornado: hyper, breathless, always spinning and out of control.

villains/m_slime.description: Sludge Slime: gurgly, bubbly, gloopy voice that oozes.

villains/m_troll.description: Grumpy Tiara Troll: deep, grumbly, cranky troll who mutters.

villains/m_booger.description: Baron von Booger: snooty, nasal, fake-posh baron who sniffs.

villains/m_stink.description: Sir Toots-a-Lot: pompous medieval knight, muffled inside stinky armor.
